title: RE/MAX Germany
description: Company internal records financial, Broker, Customers purchase, Invoice, Passwords, and 86GB of Outlook archive [eislingen@remax.de, t.maier@1-goeppinger-sv.de, thorsten.maier@remax.de, and other] RE/MAX Germany specializes in real estate services, including the buying, selling, and renting of residential and commercial properties. They also offer opportunities for individuals to become real estate agents or franchisees, emphasizing professional training and a strong support network. Their unique digital offering, DAVEit, aims to provide transparent and fair pricing for buyers and sellers. With a commitment to high-quality standards and customer satisfaction, RE/MAX is recognized as a global leader in the real estate market.
